sql: /* ashlar concurrent_ranges_r454 concurrent-3 */ SELECT count(*),count_if(b.id IS NULL OR NOT (b.source_system<=>s.source_system AND b.rel_type_id<=>s.rel_type_id AND b.id<=>s.id AND b.source_type<=>s.source_type AND b.source_id<=>s.source_id AND b.target_type<=>s.target_type AND b.target_id<=>s.target_id AND b.order_key<=>s.order_key AND b.schema_revision<=>s.schema_revision AND b.entity_version<=>s.entity_version AND b.props_json<=>s.props_json AND b.retained_json<=>s.retained_json AND b.source_feed<=>s.source_feed AND b.source_epoch<=>s.source_epoch AND b.source_position<=>s.source_position AND b.published_at<=>s.published_at AND b.apply_batch_id<=>s.apply_batch_id AND b.source_cursor_json<=>s.source_cursor_json AND b.source_delivery_id<=>s.source_delivery_id AND b.lookup_hash<=>s.lookup_hash)) FROM (SELECT * FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.prepared_current_mutation_r445 VERSION AS OF 0 WHERE lookup_hash >= 'd0' AND lookup_hash < 'd4') s LEFT JOIN client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.lc_second_edge_current_r337 VERSION AS OF 6 b ON b.lookup_hash=s.lookup_hash AND b.source_system=s.source_system AND b.rel_type_id=s.rel_type_id AND b.id=s.id
